newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kolbenschmidt shares suspended from trade.
newsitem.headline: Kolbenschmidt shares suspended from trade.

text.p: Shares in German car components group Kolbenschmidt AG were suspended from trade early on Tuesday in advance of an expected announcement, the Stuttgart bourse said in a statement.
Kolbenschmidt said it expected to see a big change in share ownership in the current year, while Commerzbank AG said that a decision on a transfer of its Kolbenschmidt stake was imminent.
"We are expecting a huge change in share ownership in the current year," Kolbenschmidt spokesman Jakob Lux said in Neckarsulm, explaining why shares in the group were suspended.
Lux went on to say that the supervisory board of the company involved was meeting on Wednesday and a decision on the changes would be made then.
Commerzbank told Reuters that a decision was imminent. The bank holds 24.99 percent of Kolbenschmidt.
